text: Read-only authority audit of current Mote HEAD 2f38536: CandidateReconciliationAuthority has only ProposalAuthorizer. CLI reconcile rejects unless candidate.authorizer == actor, constructs proposal-authorizer-produced reachability evidence, and reducer repeats both authority and producer checks. Existing successor-authorizer containment exists only for candidate supersede; it requires a pending same-entity successor and records phase=superseded, which would be false for already-landed cand-1EE04B. Therefore the serialization patch alone cannot unblock Sherlock while claude-storymodel4s is absent, and the current containment supersede must not be misused. A truthful path requires either immutable authorizer return or a separately designed owner/admin successor-reconciliation authority that records forced actor, exact containment/target reachability basis, original policy snapshot, and landed_out_of_band phase.
